isabel.ortiz: Auditor requested a lightweight, reproducible 'evidence kit' for three cases: RBAC change, KMS rotation, and vuln->incident. They want exact commands, canonical storage keys (S3/GCS), checksum+signature steps, and the mapping to our SOC2/ISO control IDs. Can owners confirm they can produce kits by Fri?

artifact-bot: I can create placeholders for object keys. Please confirm upload prefixes.

ben.turner: I'll own RBAC. Short flow: capture code change (PR + approvals), infra plan output, cloud audit slice, and cluster subject snapshot. Example commands (AWS + GKE):

```bash
# terraform plan export
terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan > /tmp/tfplan.json

# Cloud audit slice (CloudTrail)
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" \
  --filter-pattern "AttachRolePolicy|PutRolePolicy|AddUserToGroup|RemoveUserFromGroup" \
  --start-time 1710000000000 --end-time 1710000360000 > /tmp/iam_activity.json

# k8s subjects snapshot
kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding,role,clusterrole -o yaml --all-namespaces > /tmp/k8s_rbac.yaml
```

ben.turner: Canonical upload: s3://evidence-kit/rbac/{ticket_id}/{ts}/tfplan.json, iam_activity.json, k8s_rbac.yaml, approvals.pdf, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc. Manifest format: "<sha256>  <filename>" per line. Sign with GPG: `gpg --local-user ben@redwood --armor --detach-sign manifest.txt`. This evidence supports SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO 27001 A.9.2.

kevin.li: I'll take KMS rotations. We support AWS KMS and GCP KMS; here are examples for AWS: 

```bash
# key snapshot
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-encrypt > /tmp/key_snapshot.json

# key policy
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/prod-encrypt --policy-name default > /tmp/key_policy.json

# find related CloudTrail events
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" \
  --filter-pattern "CreateKey|RotateKey|DisableKey|ScheduleKeyDeletion" \
  --start-time 1710000000000 --end-time 1710000360000 > /tmp/kms_events.json

# evidence of envelope usage (example: object metadata showing encryption-context)
aws s3api head-object --bucket prod-backups --key backups/2024/dec/enc-0001.tar.gz > /tmp/object_meta.json
```

kevin.li: Upload prefix: s3://evidence-kit/kms/{key_alias}/{ts}/key_snapshot.json, key_policy.json, kms_events.json, object_meta.json, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc. We encrypt the final bundle with the CMK and record the key_arn in the manifest. Control mapping: SOC2 CC6.2, ISO 27001 A.10.

auditor_mia: For incidents I need ticket -> timeline -> build artifact hash -> deploy trace -> alert dumps -> redacted chat transcript. Also need to know who signed the manifest and how to verify.

isabel.ortiz: Incident flow (minimal): capture ticket export, the PR(s) addressing the vuln, CI artifact hash, deployment trace, and monitoring alerts. Example commands: 

```bash
# ticket export (Jira example)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $JIRA_TOKEN" "https://redwood.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/issue/$TICKET" > /tmp/issue.json

# build artifact hash
sha256sum artifacts/output.tar.gz > /tmp/artifact.sha256

# deployment trace
curl -s "https://deploy.internal/api/trace/$DEPLOY_ID" > /tmp/deploy_trace.json

# alerts snapshot (Prometheus)
curl -g "https://prometheus/api/v1/query_range?query=ALERTS&start=1710000000&end=1710000360" > /tmp/alerts.json

# slack/export (redact before adding)
/compliance/export_slack --channel incident-bridge --start 1710000000 --end 1710000360 > /tmp/slack_raw.txt
python3 /tools/redact_slack.py /tmp/slack_raw.txt /tmp/slack_redacted.txt
```

isabel.ortiz: Incident upload: s3://evidence-kit/incidents/{ticket_id}/{ts}/issue.json, artifact.sha256, deploy_trace.json, alerts.json, slack_redacted.txt, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc. Maps to SOC2 CC7.1 and ISO 27001 A.16.

auditor_mia: How do you ensure chain-of-custody and long-term immutability? I need to reproduce verification steps: sha256sum verify and GPG verification. Also ask about retention and whether raw logs are archived.
\eartifact-bot: Note: replaced typo.

ben.turner: Chain-of-custody: uploader runs `sha256sum` to produce manifest, then signs manifest with GPG. CI pipeline that performs the upload appends metadata: uploader=<user>, ci_run=<id>, upload_time=<iso>. For finalization we set S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) with retention period 7 years and copy a sealed archive to Glacier Deep. Raw Slack transcripts are retained only under SecOps JIT access; the auditor receives redacted exports.

kevin.li: Verification steps we provide to auditors: 

```bash
# download manifest and signature
aws s3 cp s3://evidence-kit/rbac/TKT-1234/1710000000/manifest.txt .
aws s3 cp s3://evidence-kit/rbac/TKT-1234/1710000000/manifest.txt.asc .

# verify checksums
sha256sum -c manifest.txt

# verify signature
gpg --verify manifest.txt.asc manifest.txt
```

kevin.li: We also publish a small README in each bundle with the control mappings and the canonical verification commands.

auditor_mia: Good. Can you attach one RBAC kit and one KMS kit to audit task AUD-2026-900 and include the exact S3 keys and the GPG public keys for verification? I'll run the verification on Mon.

isabel.ortiz: Will produce sample kits and push to s3://evidence-kit/samples/ by EOD and update AUD-2026-900 with keys and README.

auditor_mia: Thanks — please notify when samples are uploaded.
